recognize_zh: 高倍可見小淋巴細胞與具較多淡染或空泡狀細胞質、核略不規則的邊緣區樣細胞及組織球混雜，另有少數漿細胞，缺乏成片大型芽細胞；這種多樣的細胞組成是皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤的典型背景。
features: Mixed population of small lymphocytes with dark round nuclei and medium-sized cells with oval to slightly irregular nuclei
Many cells with pale to clear, vacuolated cytoplasm (marginal zone/monocytoid B cells and histiocytes)
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, not forming sheets
Few plasma cells and epithelioid histiocytes admixed
Dermal collagen bundle at upper left
describe_en: High-power view of the dermal infiltrate shows a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, medium-sized marginal zone-type cells with pale to vacuolated cytoplasm and slightly irregular nuclei, scattered histiocytes and a few plasma cells. Occasional larger cells with vesicular chromatin are present but do not form confluent sheets. Mitotic activity is not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with the cellular composition of primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma, to be confirmed with immunohistochemistry and light-chain studies.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, rather than scattered large cells in a small-cell background.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; immunostains show predominance of PD-1-positive CD4 T cells without monotypic plasma cells.
Reactive infiltrates can look identical at high power; distinction relies on architecture and light-chain restriction.
